scope: Paired language diagnostic on 75 official-WildGuardTrain original-text parents of 79 internal Chinese disagreement cases
binary_labels: unchanged official prompt_harm_label; category_id is descriptive only
selection: 79-row union selected historically from Chinese seed42..46 probability-mean predictions at 0.5
prompt_mode: raw, no chat template, add_special_tokens=False, no truncation
representation: 32 raw block outputs at last valid token, before final norm, float16; same capture as source
limitations: Cases are selected for Chinese model disagreement; subset scores are not population language accuracy; original_english is a legacy field name and some original prompts may be non-English.
One Chinese-task-adapted E03 LoRA is shared across languages; language and training-distribution sensitivity remain.
Text review is an assistant semantic review, not new human binary gold.
